dataset: India Air Quality Database, XKDR Forum
source: CPCB Continuous Ambient Air Quality Monitoring network (CAAQM)
attribution: XKDR Forum (2026), India Air Quality Database; source network: CPCB CAAQM
aggregation: Daily mean/min/max/count per station and pollutant; timestamps are IST.
limitations: Measurements are published as received without validation or gap filling. This archive does not publish AQI; no AQI was derived from these two pollutants. Although the archive metadata lists coverage through 2026-03, direct daily queries returned no observations after 2025-09-01; the downloaded file reflects the records actually returned.
